items.resolution: Keep raw algorithm/output; prove and label only half-tie-dependent categorical discrepancies using complete per-iteration traces; do not snap results

items.issue: Release cancellation initially restored a partial result into retained Worker state
items.resolution: Release-specific cancellation retains partial in terminal event but never restores held state; actual-thread regression passes

items.issue: Intermediate Python oracle edit had an unmatched parenthesis during a concurrent regression attempt
items.resolution: Correct syntax and rerun full regression after fixture worker is stable

items.issue: Independent review reproduced dropped completed payloads when older completion was deferred behind an unacknowledged newer request and then cancelled or superseded
items.resolution: v2 preserves terminal result, deferred result, or latest partial per request; includes analogous release/dispose/failure/restart paths; stale evidence never notifies current UI or overwrites current partial cache

items.issue: Independent actual-Worker all-zero-population export lost negative-zero signs through JSON.stringify
items.resolution: v3 codec v2 encodes strict signed-zero tags for scalars and Float64Array elements; Python decoder supports the same representation; three actual-Worker exact round trips pass

items.issue: Extreme finite P1 likelihood collapsed distinct residual distances, yielding wrong .5 probability and converged status despite analytic LLR4e18
items.resolution: v3 rejects numerically unresolved local BPSK likelihoods with NUMERICAL_CONDITIONING via an algebraically equivalent LLR used only as a resolution check; no decoded probability rewrite; zero/weak gains remain supported
